_comment: RU routing pipeline - sing-box lite example. Placeholder tokens {{VERSION}} and {{CDN_BASE}} are substituted at build time by ru_routing.render.render_examples. node-example is a documented placeholder outbound tag: replace its address/credentials with a real inter-node deployment before use.

rules._comment: 1. Private/local domains and IP traffic to DIRECT via the generated private rule set and sing-box's native ip_is_private condition.
2. spy category to BLOCK (lite's only default-blocked thematic category).
3. Trusted RU and Russia-only traffic to DIRECT.

route._final_comment: 4. Unmatched traffic to PROXY: lite protects a client behind a VPN, so unrecognized destinations must not silently bypass the tunnel. This is also where the (server-only) 'blocked' domains/IPs land, since lite no longer carries an explicit blocked rule-set -- proxying by default already covers them.

outbounds._comment: Replace with the real upstream/VPN outbound (shadowsocks, vmess, trojan, ...) for your deployment.
PLACEHOLDER outbound tag for deployment-specific inter-node routing. Replace address/credentials before deployment. Not used by the lite policy; kept for interface parity with the server example.
